# Set WiFi

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the state of the devices WiFi connection.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setWiFi(state: <#BoolNumb#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setWiFi(state: true)
~~~~
